pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are indefinite and reflexive pronouns?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly
2. use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns.
4. Show that you can: identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen to an audio on wildlife from a digital device and write down the indefinite and reflexive pronouns from the audio text,
2. Collaborate to construct sentences using indefinite and reflexive pronouns,
3. Citizenship: It is promoted as the learner listens to a text on wildlife resources hence caring for others and the environment.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are indefinite and reflexive pronouns?
2. Why do we use indefinite pronouns?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly
2. use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
